method.inference_backend: make_fx -> aot_module_simplified -> compile_fx_inner; no Dynamo inference frontend
method.thread_affinity: GPU0 CPU8 + monitor16; GPU1 CPU40 + monitor48
method.uncertainty: independent processes are replicates; frame counts and conditional block intervals do not prove population equivalence
method.rejected_rule: a change below 3% is not automatically noise

primary_same_context_normal_api.confidence_note: processes, not frames, are independent replicates; conditional block intervals do not establish population equivalence
primary_same_context_normal_api.scope: normal full ASE API, both implementations in one CUDA context; two calculators, actual master and exact PR definitions; no Dynamo inference frontend

clock_matched_sensitivity.criteria: block mean SM clock difference <=0.5%, both memory clocks 13801MHz, mean temperature difference <=2C
clock_matched_sensitivity.caveat: post-stratified sensitivity analysis; conditioning can change composition and does not prove constant clocks or replace full results

controlled_main_r2.t_interval_caveat: t interval over independent process-pair means; n=2 is calibration only, not a precise population estimate
controlled_main_r2.interval_method: resample independent process pairs, then ABBA blocks within each selected pair; frame samples are not iid replicates
controlled_main_r2.interpretation: interval crosses zero: unresolved sign, not proof of zero cost
controlled_main_r2.memory_scope: resident timing only; retain independent cold-first/full-window capacity measurements separately

controlled_native_r1.interpretation: interval crosses zero: unresolved sign, not proof of zero cost
controlled_native_r1.memory_scope: resident timing only; retain independent cold-first/full-window capacity measurements separately

invalid_diagnostics: Two launcher-inspection failures before controlled timing; no comparative result used.
One own-worker initialization cancelled after inspection incompatibility was identified.
Two graph-replay setup failures (bound method / missing no_grad); not candidate numerical failures.
limitations: Neo N64 only; no new multi-model/PT2/large-edge acceptance.
Only partial Megakernels scheduling ideas are used, not its runtime or a cross-layer mega-kernel.
No stable speedup or exact zero-cost guarantee; initialization-order effect observed, low-level mechanism not uniquely attributed.
The natural-stride experiment was not adopted; it did not demonstrate a repeatable benefit.
Large-edge make_fx/AOT dispatch must be checked separately; Dynamo boundary unit tests are not AOT deployment acceptance.
